checks.label: Duplicate payment verification
checks.detail: No high-confidence duplicates after filtering 197 batch payments and 4671 CSV overlaps. Previous false positives eliminated.

checks.label: Split payment analysis
checks.detail: 173 suspect instances (£47.5M, 2.9% of spend). Threshold: 5+ payments to same supplier in same week, 80%+ of approval limit.

checks.label: CH breach temporal verification
checks.detail: 6 suppliers with £197.3K confirmed during active breach periods. Enrichment errors excluded. Only dated violations with confirmed overlap flagged.

checks.label: Cross-council price comparison
checks.detail: 24 shared suppliers found. 8 with >200% price gap (requiring 3+ transactions each side). Extreme disparities (>10,000%) filtered as different service scopes.

checks.label: Benford's Law forensic screening
checks.detail: Significant deviation from Benford's Law (p < 0.001). χ²=5058.98 on 137324 amounts >£100. Largest deviation: digit 4 (3.8% off expected).

warnings: 8 suppliers show >200% price disparity after filtering. These are more likely genuine value concerns than extreme outliers.

Benford's Law analysis shows significant deviation (χ²=5058.98). Digit 4 deviates 3.8% from expected. This warrants investigation but can also occur with legitimate round-number grants or threshold-based payments.
